issue.title: How to define empty query parameters as missing?
If the query parameter type is int, an error will be reported if an empty string is passed from the front end

issue.body:
[QueryParams](https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/852181a5c0aa25c5e14574a21acdb3c10acb7839/starlette/datastructures.py#L380) currently supports only query parameters with a value, however, query parameters without a value are still be valid and should be supported?

```
#!/usr/bin/env python
from starlette.datastructures import QueryParams

with_value = QueryParams('param=value')
print("with_value:", with_value)

without_value = QueryParams('param')
print("without_value:", without_value)
```
Result:
```
with_value: param=value
without_value:
```

Expected result:
```
with_value: param=value
without_value: param
```

Any comments on this?
issue.title: QueryParams support for parameter without value
How to define empty query parameters as missing?
If the query parameter type is int, an error will be reported if an empty string is passed from the front end
